logger.doc:name: Log Fetching Billing Records
logger.message: #["[DEBUG] Fetching billing records | JobId: " ++ vars.jobId ++ " | Since: " ++ (vars.lastProcessedTimestamp as String)]

db:select.doc:name: Select Billing Records
db:select.db:sql: SELECT id, customer_id, account_number, billing_period_start, billing_period_end, usage_amount, rate_plan_id, status, created_at, updated_at FROM billing_records WHERE updated_at > :lastProcessedTimestamp AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY updated_at ASC

logger.doc:name: Log Fetching Invoice Records
logger.message: #["[DEBUG] Fetching invoice records | JobId: " ++ vars.jobId ++ " | Since: " ++ (vars.lastInvoiceProcessedTimestamp as String)]

db:select.doc:name: Select Invoice Records
db:select.db:sql: SELECT c.id as customer_id, c.name as customer_name, c.email as customer_email, c.billing_address, c.tax_id, b.id as billing_id, b.billing_period_start, b.billing_period_end, b.total_amount, b.tax_amount, b.status, b.created_at, b.updated_at FROM customers c INNER JOIN billing_summary b ON c.id = b.customer_id WHERE b.updated_at > :lastInvoiceProcessedTimestamp AND b.status = 'READY_FOR_INVOICE' ORDER BY b.updated_at ASC
